title: Chapter 322 I Killed Him
content:
Chapter 322 I Killed Him

Finally, Lu Daosheng left.

This clone slowly turned into several balls of light and drifted in this world.

At the same time, beyond the distant galaxy.

Lu Daosheng suddenly opened his eyes.

On the side, Yan Lingyun looked at Lu Daosheng, "So fast?"

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, "I have no worries."

After saying that, Lu Daosheng slowly stood up and waved his sleeves towards the abyss in front of him.

The next moment, a hazy barrier gradually condensed, completely separating the two sides of the abyss.

"This line of defense will begin to become weaker and weaker at this moment. At the moment I agreed with Xiaoxue, it will completely dissipate."

After Lu Daosheng finished speaking, he turned around and looked in the direction of the fairy world again.

I watched it for a long time.

Now, he believes that Lu Xue will succeed.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng spread his right hand.

Several fireflies-like balls inside were trembling slightly, which was the agreement he made with the guy on the other side of the abyss.

The battle of luck will eventually come as scheduled.

I believe that only after the Battle of Luck ends, my daughter will truly soar into the sky and be unstoppable.

With a wave of his hand, several groups of light suddenly sank into the void and headed towards the fairy world.

After doing all this, Lu Daosheng pulled Yan Lingyun's slender jade hand and left this world.

At this time, Lu Xue, who was still in the ancient battlefield of the Immortal World, did not know that she had been truly stocked.

Being in the bronze palace, Lu Xue no longer thought about it.

With a slight movement of thought, Lu Xue's body appeared directly outside the bronze palace.

At this time, Xiao Luo and others were waiting for Lu Xue outside. When they saw Lu Xue, the few people looked excited and hurried forward.

"Sister Xue, how about it?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue smiled slightly, "Everything is in control."

At this time, Lu Xue noticed Tang Hao and others.

This time, Tang Hao and others' gains were very small, and they were seriously injured, which basically caused a loss.

After a moment of silence, Lu Xue spread her palms and several rings appeared in Lu Xue's hands.

"For you."

Looking at the rings appearing in their hands, everyone frowned slightly.

"What do you mean?"

"If I hadn't been to you, I wouldn't have made a breakthrough, and I wouldn't have obtained the inheritance of the Bronze Palace. This is what you deserve."

Lu Xue smiled faintly.

Hearing this, Ye Wuwei curled his lips and said, "Haha, that's right. You have gotten all the good things in the entire Bronze Palace. You want to send us some rags."

At this time, Chu Xingyue, who was standing beside her, suddenly said to Lu Xue, "Thank you Miss Lu Xue. If Miss Lu Xue has something to do in the future, you can come to the Chu clan to find me, and I will do my best."

Ye Wuwei:?

Immediately afterwards, Tang Hao also exclaimed, "Damn it!"

The rest of the people took a deep breath.

Seeing this, Ye Wuwei also noticed something was wrong and quickly inserted his spiritual sense into the ring.

Feeling the massive immortal crystals piled up in the ring and countless magic pills, Ye Wuwei suddenly felt like he was being kept.

So many resources are enough for him to practice to the late stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

In an instant, Ye Wuwei's expression became solemn and he said seriously to Lu Xue: "Miss Lu Xue, I unilaterally announce that you will be my Ye Wuwei's friend in the future."

Upon hearing this, Tang Hao angrily exclaimed: "Are you shameless? Junior Sister Lu Xue is from my Tiandi Academy."

The rest of the people from Tiandi Academy nodded in agreement, "That's it."

Ye Wuwei said shamelessly: "What's wrong with Tiandi Academy? I, Ye Wuwei, can join."

"Haha, my Tiandi Academy only has people with excellent moral character."

"Stop farting, then Chu Lingsheng is also both moral and moral?"

Chu Lingsheng:?

With Lu Xue's operation, Lu Xue completely won the support of everyone.

And at this moment, a loud voice suddenly came from afar.

Everyone looked in the sound and saw a man who looked like a young man slowly walking towards the place.

"Lu Xue, haha, I finally found you. I didn't expect that you have the ability to come here."

Hearing this, Lu Xue frowned slightly.

I saw that it was the young man who had survived the emperor's robbery that he met outside the ancient battlefield.

Zhao Si!

"It's you? No, it's you an old guy!"

Lu Xue's expression was gloomy and she immediately recognized the true identity of the person in front of her.

In response to this, Zhao Si laughed and said, "You are still as wise as a torch."

At this time, Xiao Luo stood up and said, "Old guy, are you stupid? Can't you see so many people here?"

Everyone around him stared at Zhao Si with an unkind look on his face.

Upon hearing this, Zhao Si said disdainfully: "There are many people, what's the use of having too many people? They are just a group of ants. No matter how embarrassed I am, it is not something you dolls can deal with."

"As long as you are in the ancient battlefield, you will destroy you like ants."

After saying that, Zhao Si looked at Lu Xue and continued, "If you are conscious, you will present your body to me, and I can give you some fun."

Hearing his words, Lu Xue asked, "What if it wasn't in the ancient battlefield?"

This question made Zhao Si frown slightly, but gradually let go, "Ha, can you still have the ability to escape from here in front of me?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue shook her head slightly.

The next moment, a bronze palace appeared in her hands.

In a blink of an eye, the bronze palace expanded rapidly, eventually covering the entire space.

In the bronze palace, it is isolated from the outside world and forms a world of its own.

Zhao Si, who was in the bronze palace, finally panicked.

"You! How is this possible?"

His current source of power is based on the ancient battlefield.

Now, without the blessing of the ancient battlefield, the power he can use is only Zhao Si's original strength.

With Zhao Si's strength, he is really seeking death.

In response, Lu Xue shook her head slightly, "Old guy, times have changed."

The sound of the sword sounded.

The next moment, an old monster who has survived to this day fell directly.

This section is just a small episode for Lu Xue and others.

Afterwards, everyone practiced on the ancient battlefield for a while.

Until ten years later.

At this moment, outside the ancient battlefield.

Several terrifying auras made the atmosphere here extremely depressed.

A white-haired old man in a black robe looked gloomy at the moment, and his bright eyes were staring at the exit of the ancient battlefield.

The others had different expressions.

There are worries, solemnity, and gloating.

At this time, the exit of the ancient battlefield that had been silent for a long time finally trembled again.

In the past decade, the number of people entering the ancient battlefield has almost reached the highest level in history.

The ancient battlefield has also truly entered the eyes of the world.

However, even so, if you want to enter the ancient battlefield, you still need to be recognized by the four ancient tribes.

In other words, it is either talented or has a strong background, and both are indispensable.

Otherwise, I wouldn't even be able to reach the gate of the ancient battlefield.

The strong men of the ancient clan are not vegetarians.

Under the gaze of everyone, more than a dozen figures slowly walked out from the exit of the ancient battlefield.

Seeing these dozen figures, all the strong people present couldn't help but be stunned.

I saw that it was Tiandi Academy and others headed by Lu Xue.

However, this was not over yet, and a moment later, the exit of the ancient battlefield trembled again.

Immediately afterwards, the Chu genius headed by Chu Xingyue slowly walked out of it.

At this moment, when seeing Lu Xue and others, the Xiao clan members quickly breathed a sigh of relief.

In their eyes, as long as Lu Xue is fine.

It seems that they were worried about the past.

"grandfather!"

Seeing Xiao Mo and other powerful people in the Xiao clan, Xiao Luo looked overjoyed and hurried forward.

Lu Xue and Qin Feng looked at each other and followed Xiao Luo toward the powerful people of the Xiao clan.

Tang Hao and others headed towards Li Changqing, Tiandi Academy.

And at this moment, a sensational pressure suddenly came.

"Wait a moment!"

The white-haired old man suddenly stood up and stared at the younger generation who had just walked out of the ancient battlefield with a bad expression.

When Tang Hao saw the old man with white hair, his expression was slightly dark.

He knew the identity of the old man with gray hair.

Chen Mingyu's father.

A terrifying powerful man at the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

"Old Gui Chen, what do you want to do? Do you want to do whatever you want here?!"

Xiao Mo looked at Old Gui Chen coldly and said a little displeased.

Upon hearing this, Old Gui Chen looked a little ugly, but he still said in a deep voice: "Class Chief Xiao, it's not that I'm rude, but that my son Chen Mingyu died in the ancient battlefield. I must have an explanation."

Hearing Chen Laogui's words, Xiao Mo snorted, "What do you want to explain?"

"I want to find the murderer who killed my son!"

As soon as these words came out, everyone was shocked.

"You mean, is your son being harmed?"

"That's natural. My son is talented, so how could he die in the ancient battlefield? There must be a villain in it!"

Chen Laogui looked angry and his eyes kept scanning the younger generation who had just come out of the ancient battlefield.

Especially Tang Hao and Chu Xingyue.

The possibility of these two people is the greatest in Chen Laogui's eyes.

Because the others do not have the strength to defeat his son.

But at this moment, he didn't dare to make any guesses, otherwise he might fall into trouble. After all, the forces behind these two people are not just for a good meal.

Unless, he has any evidence.

At this moment, Ye Tian of the Ye tribe suddenly stood up and said, "Senior Chen, before I left the ancient battlefield, Chen Mingyu was in a bronze palace. At that time, almost all the geniuses in the ancient battlefield were in it. I think , If you know who has gained the most in the bronze palace, you should know the cause of your son's death."

Everyone was shocked at Ye Tian's sudden rise.

However, the powerful Ye clan just frowned and said nothing.

It has nothing to do with them anyway.

The geniuses of their Ye clan almost retreated early.

Next, they just need to watch the show.

Faced with the sudden addition of fire by Ye Tian, everyone in the Tiandi Academy looked gloomy.

Chu Xingyue, who was on the Chu clan, also had a slightly frown on her eyebrows.

"Bronze Palace?"

Chen Laogui's eyes were inflamed and he immediately looked at Tang Hao and others.

"Tell me, who has gained the most in the Bronze Palace?"

Faced with Chen Laogui's questioning, Li Changqing of Tiandi Academy directly blocked Tang Hao and others.

"Old Gui Chen, even if your son is killed, he is not as skilled as others. Do you still want to attack the younger generation?"

Hearing this, Old Gui Chen had a ferocious face, "I am just this son! So what if I take action against the younger generation? As long as I can avenge my son, I can pay any price!"

At this moment, the hostility in Chen Laogui was almost about to turn into reality.

Seeing this, even Li Changqing looked fearful.

Facing a peak Immortal Emperor Realm who cares about consequences, any force will feel a headache.

Because if you want to suppress the other party, you must have strong strength.

Otherwise, even if the other party can't beat it, he will run away.

Once the other party hides in the dark, it will inevitably target other people within the power.

It's impossible that everyone never goes out.

"I'll ask you the last time, do you know it or not, otherwise, don't blame me for killing you!"

Chen Laogui looked at Tang Hao and others and questioned again.

He had no good feelings for Tiandi Academy and his words were very convincing.

Li Changqing's face turned completely dark at this moment.

Tang Hao and others were about to speak when a voice suddenly came from the Xiao clan.

"Your son, I'll kill it."

As soon as these words came out, the audience suddenly became silent.
